zh-CN.title: 登录更快捷
items: PWA 登录首页重新支持选择本机最近登录过的账号，一步返回对应空间
仍可展开空间名输入区登录其他空间，退出或登录失效的账号会自动移除

en.title: Faster sign-in
items: The PWA account entry once again lets you return to a recently signed-in account in one step
You can still expand the space field to sign in elsewhere, while signed-out or expired accounts are removed automatically
